name: rf-tab
after: (() => { for (let i = 0; i < 4 && !document.activeElement?.classList?.contains('hs-btn'); i++) document.querySelector('.hs-btn[tabindex="0"]')?.focus(); return document.activeElement?.className; })()

name: rf-enter
after: (() => { const a = document.activeElement; if (a?.id !== 'journal-title') throw new Error('reduced motion: focus is on ' + a?.tagName + '#' + a?.id + ', not the journal title'); return a.id; })()

name: rf-panel
after: (() => { const a = document.activeElement; const r = document.querySelector('.journal').getBoundingClientRect(); if (a?.id !== 'journal-title') throw new Error('focus left the title: ' + a?.tagName); if (r.left >= innerWidth) throw new Error('the page is still off-screen'); return JSON.stringify({ focus: a.id, left: Math.round(r.left) }); })()

name: rf-next-tab
after: (() => { const a = document.activeElement; if (!document.querySelector('.journal').contains(a)) throw new Error('Tab left the page: ' + a?.tagName + '.' + a?.className); return a.tagName + '.' + a.className; })()

name: rf-esc
after: (() => { const a = document.activeElement; return JSON.stringify({ open: __woodland.ctx.ui.isPanelOpen, focus: a?.tagName + '.' + (a?.className || a?.id) }); })()

name: rf-label
after: (() => { for (let i = 0; i < 12 && !document.activeElement?.classList?.contains('spot-label'); i++) document.querySelector('.spot-label.is-shown')?.focus(); const a = document.activeElement; if (!a?.classList?.contains('spot-label')) throw new Error('no overview label took focus: ' + a?.tagName + '.' + a?.className); return a.getAttribute('aria-label'); })()

name: rf-label-arrived
eval: (() => { const a = document.activeElement; if (!a?.classList?.contains('hs-btn')) throw new Error('arriving from an overview label: focus is on ' + a?.tagName + '.' + a?.className + ', not on the first ✦ (.hs-btn)'); return JSON.stringify({ spot: __woodland.ctx.cameraRig.spot, focus: a.getAttribute('aria-label') }); })()

name: rf-label-tab
after: (() => { const a = document.activeElement; if (!a?.classList?.contains('hs-btn')) throw new Error('label Enter → Tab landed on ' + a?.tagName + '.' + a?.className + ', not on a ✦ (.hs-btn)'); return a.getAttribute('aria-label'); })()

name: rf-map-pin
eval: (() => { const pin = [...document.querySelectorAll('.map-pin')].find((b) => /Velowerkstatt/.test(b.getAttribute('aria-label') || '')); if (!pin) throw new Error('no Velowerkstatt pin on the map'); pin.focus(); return pin.getAttribute('aria-label'); })()

name: rf-map-arrived
eval: (() => { const a = document.activeElement; if (!a?.classList?.contains('hs-btn') && !a?.classList?.contains('hs-layer')) throw new Error('arriving from a map pin: focus is on ' + a?.tagName + '.' + a?.className + ', not on the place\'s ✦'); return JSON.stringify({ spot: __woodland.ctx.cameraRig.spot, focus: a.getAttribute('aria-label') }); })()
